item.title: 3 people hospitalized after car is torn in half in high-speed crash on Jamacha Road
item.description: Three people have been transported to the hospital after a crash tore a sedan in half and seriously damaged another car.

item.title: ABC 10News Pinpoint Weather with Max Goldwasser: Much cooler weather Monday with chances for showers
item.description: So you know that amazingly hot weekend with record-setting temperatures we've had? Yeah, that'll be long gone by the time Monday rolls around, bringing with it some chances for showers.

item.title: SDPD investigating suspicious death
item.description: Sam Diego Police are investigating a suspicious death in University City after finding an deceased woman in unusual circumstances late Friday night.
